titleEn: All G makes US debut with low-iron lactoferrin made via precision fermentation
titleZh: All G 凭借精准发酵低铁乳铁蛋白首次进入美国市场
summaryZh: 澳大利亚初创公司 All G 凭借其通过精准发酵生产的牛乳铁蛋白类似物 LFX apo-乳铁蛋白首次进入美国市场。该产品的铁饱和度低于 5%，远低于传统乳源乳铁蛋白的约 20%。公司声称其技术可在商业规模实现低铁饱和度，且单位经济性为正。产品已获 FDA GRAS 无异议函，目前以每年数吨规模生产，并计划推出人乳铁蛋白版本。文章还分析了该技术对活性营养、肠道健康、免疫支持等市场的潜在影响。
featuredReason: 尽管该新闻主要聚焦于食品科技和精准发酵，但乳铁蛋白作为功能性饲料添加剂在奶牛养殖（尤其是犊牛健康、乳房炎防控）中具有潜在应用价值，值得关注其技术进展对畜牧业的间接影响。
contentFull:
Australian startup All G has made its US debut with LFX apo-lactoferrin, bovine-equivalent lactoferrin made via precision fermentation with less than 5% iron saturation.

An iron-binding anti-microbial protein found in mammalian milk, lactoferrin has multiple health benefits, but has historically only been available in small quantities owing to the high cost of isolating it from cow’s milk.

As a result, prices can top $650/kilo, making it an attractive candidate for firms in precision fermentation, who claim they can unlock new markets in active nutrition, gut health, healthy aging, women’s health, immune support, and infant formula.

With multiple startups now piling into the segment (Vivici, All G, PFerrinX, TurtleTree, Helaina, Eclipse Ingredients, PFx Biotech, Daisy Labs, and Noumi), some players are attempting to differentiate themselves by modulating levels of iron saturation.

In its “apo” state, lactoferrin acts as a sponge for free iron and starves harmful bacteria and fungi that rely on iron to survive, claims All G.

“When iron saturation is low, empty iron-binding sites can bind excess free iron and help regulate homeostasis, limit iron available to harmful bacteria, support gut health, promote immune cell activity, and improve dietary iron absorption without requiring more iron to be consumed. The result is a fundamentally different approach to iron management. LFX works as an iron regulator, not just an iron source.”

An industry first

CSO and cofounder Jared Raynes, PhD, told AgFunderNews: “Although we welcome any competition, achieving a low iron saturation at commercial scale is significantly more challenging than at lab scale and we have yet to see any other company prove that it can be done.

“From publicly available data relating to our precision fermentation competitors, they are producing lactoferrin that is very highly saturated. On top of our low iron saturation, our product carries over 93% protein content, over 95% purity and over 95% binding to heparin – the latest industry standard measure for bioactivity.”

Asked how All G’s apo-lactoferrin compared to animal-derived lactoferrin, he said: “The regular iron saturation of dairy-derived lactoferrin sits at around ~20%; whereas All G’s specification sits at below 5%. The dairy industry can only achieve apo-lactoferrin through harsh intervention in downstream processing – by lowering the pH in order to strip the iron from the lactoferrin.”

According to Raynes, this process is “well known to degrade the protein. Up until now, apo-lactoferrin has only been offered for pharmaceutical applications as the price is close to double the price of partly saturated lactoferrin.”

All G achieves the low iron saturation during the fermentation process rather than through the downstream processing, says CSO Jared Raynes. Image credit: All G
Positive unit economics

All G, which has an FDA GRAS ‘no questions’ letter for its bovine lactoferrin, has proven its tech at pilot scale with Döhler and is scaling up with contract manufacturers, said the firm, which is currently producing LFX at a scale of “multiple metric tons per year.”

CEO Jan Pacas added: “We are currently producing at 60,000-liter scale and at a yield that is giving us positive unit economics when selling at the current market price of milk-derived lactoferrin.

“We are producing with one of the top global fermentation CMOs in China that gives us the scale and quality consistency that will allow us to scale precision fermented lactoferrin globally. Talks of a second facility, likely in Europe, are well underway. On this part we are leveraging our established relationships with our joint venture partner Savencia [a leading producer of bovine lactoferrin] and our strategic investor Döhler. All G keeps local stock in the US for fast fulfilment of US customers.”

The firm, which is backed by investors including Agronomics and Döhler Ventures, recently announced a joint venture with French dairy ingredients expert Armor Protéines and aims to capitalize on the latter’s scientific expertise, distribution channels, and long-standing relationships with leading players in infant formula, adult nutrition, and supplements.

Human lactoferrin will also come in apo-form

All G hopes to secure self-affirmed GRAS status for human lactoferrin by the year end and aims to be on the market within six months, said Pacas.

“The data we have generated from our scale-up human lactoferrin batches is significantly superior to what is currently on the market. One thing we can share now is that our human lactoferrin will also come in apo-form, mimicking human breast milk at around 4% iron saturation. ”

He added: “We believe that human and bovine equivalent lactoferrin will co-exist, with human lactoferrin serving the markets where it makes the biggest difference such as women’s health and infant nutrition. At the same time, bovine lactoferrin remains one of the most studied and proven proteins for human health, backed by thousands of peer reviewed papers and dozens of clinical trials. We can’t simply dismiss that body of research and write off this protein just because human lactoferrin is now available.”

Bovine and human lactoferrin will be priced differently, “putting bovine in a more accessible category and keeping the option open for formulators that are price conscious,” he explained.

According to Pacas, the “main market is for supplements, but increasingly we are seeing demand come in for functional foods and sports nutrition. We expect significant growth in the total market size for lactoferrin since lack of supply has been one of the main constraints for brands.”

Raynes added: “The traditional claim areas for lactoferrin are iron absorption, gut health and immune support. For all of these claim areas, the mechanisms are strengthened by the low-iron saturation in our apo-lactoferrin.”

translationZh:
澳大利亚初创公司 All G 凭借 LFX apo-乳铁蛋白首次进入美国市场，这是一种通过精准发酵生产的牛乳铁蛋白类似物，铁饱和度低于 5%。

乳铁蛋白是一种存在于哺乳动物乳汁中的铁结合抗微生物蛋白，具有多种健康益处，但由于从牛奶中分离的成本高昂，历史上仅能少量获得。

因此，其价格可高达每公斤 650 美元，使其成为精准发酵企业的理想目标，这些企业声称可以开拓活性营养、肠道健康、健康老龄化、女性健康、免疫支持和婴儿配方奶粉等新市场。

随着多家初创公司涌入该领域（Vivici、All G、PFerrinX、TurtleTree、Helaina、Eclipse Ingredients、PFx Biotech、Daisy Labs 和 Noumi），一些参与者正试图通过调节铁饱和度水平来实现差异化。

All G 声称，在其“apo”状态下，乳铁蛋白充当游离铁的“海绵”，并抑制依赖铁生存的有害细菌和真菌。

“当铁饱和度较低时，空的铁结合位点可以结合过量的游离铁，帮助调节体内平衡，限制有害细菌可用的铁，支持肠道健康，促进免疫细胞活性，并在无需摄入更多铁的情况下改善膳食铁的吸收。其结果是一种根本不同的铁管理方法。LFX 作为铁调节剂，而不仅仅是铁来源。”

**行业首创**

首席科学官兼联合创始人 Jared Raynes 博士告诉 AgFunderNews：“虽然我们欢迎任何竞争，但在商业规模上实现低铁饱和度比实验室规模要困难得多，我们尚未看到任何其他公司证明可以做到这一点。”

“根据我们精准发酵竞争对手的公开数据，他们生产的乳铁蛋白饱和度非常高。除了我们的低铁饱和度，我们的产品蛋白质含量超过 93%，纯度超过 95%，肝素结合率超过 95%——这是最新的行业标准生物活性指标。”

当被问及 All G 的 apo-乳铁蛋白与动物源乳铁蛋白相比如何时，他说：“乳源乳铁蛋白的常规铁饱和度约为 20%；而 All G 的规格低于 5%。乳制品行业只能通过下游加工中的剧烈干预——降低 pH 值以从乳铁蛋白中剥离铁——来获得 apo-乳铁蛋白。”

据 Raynes 称，这一过程“众所周知会降解蛋白质。到目前为止，apo-乳铁蛋白仅用于制药应用，因为其价格几乎是部分饱和乳铁蛋白的两倍。”

All G 在发酵过程中而非下游加工中实现低铁饱和度。图片来源：All G

**正向单位经济性**

All G 已为其牛乳铁蛋白获得 FDA GRAS 无异议函，已与 Döhler 在试点规模验证其技术，并正在与合同制造商扩大规模。该公司表示，目前以“每年数吨”的规模生产 LFX。

首席执行官 Jan Pacas 补充道：“我们目前以 60,000 升的规模生产，产量使我们能够以当前乳源乳铁蛋白的市场价格销售，并获得正向的单位经济性。”

“我们正在与中国一家全球顶级的发酵合同生产商合作，这为我们提供了规模和质量的稳定性，使我们能够将精准发酵乳铁蛋白推向全球。关于第二家工厂（可能位于欧洲）的谈判正在进行中。在这方面，我们正在利用与合资伙伴 Savencia（一家领先的牛乳铁蛋白生产商）和战略投资者 Döhler 的既有关系。All G 在美国保持本地库存，以便快速交付美国客户。”

该公司由 Agronomics 和 Döhler Ventures 等投资者支持，最近宣布与法国乳制品配料专家 Armor Protéines 成立合资企业，旨在利用后者的科学专业知识、分销渠道以及与婴儿配方奶粉、成人营养和补充剂领域领先企业的长期关系。

**人乳铁蛋白也将以 apo 形式提供**

All G 希望在年底前获得人乳铁蛋白的自我确认 GRAS 状态，并计划在六个月内上市，Pacas 说。

“我们从扩大规模的人乳铁蛋白批次中生成的数据明显优于目前市场上的产品。我们现在可以分享的一点是，我们的人乳铁蛋白也将以 apo 形式提供，模仿母乳约 4% 的铁饱和度。”

他补充道：“我们认为人乳铁蛋白和牛乳铁蛋白类似物将共存，人乳铁蛋白服务于最能发挥作用的领域，如女性健康和婴儿营养。同时，牛乳铁蛋白仍然是研究最充分、最成熟的人类健康蛋白质之一，有数千篇同行评审论文和数十项临床试验支持。我们不能仅仅因为人乳铁蛋白现在可用就忽视这一研究体系并放弃这种蛋白质。”

牛乳铁蛋白和人乳铁蛋白将采用不同的定价，“将牛乳铁蛋白置于更易获得的类别，并为注重价格的配方师保留选择空间，”他解释道。

据 Pacas 称，“主要市场是补充剂，但我们越来越多地看到功能性食品和运动营养的需求。我们预计乳铁蛋白的总市场规模将显著增长，因为供应短缺一直是品牌面临的主要制约因素之一。”

Raynes 补充道：“乳铁蛋白的传统宣称领域是铁吸收、肠道健康和免疫支持。对于所有这些宣称领域，其机制都因我们 apo-乳铁蛋白的低铁饱和度而得到加强。”
